The low-cost vendor's quote meets the 18% target alone, so no second-source add is needed this cycle (memory_c3's dual-source lesson is noted but the line has no buffer to absorb a two-vendor transition simultaneously). I am pulling memory_c2's archive to confirm the onboarding timeline and any delivery-risk caveats before the 14-day expiry forces the switch; if the archive reveals a longer-than-expected ramp or quality flags, I would fall back to a short month-to-month bridge with the incumbent (per memory_c5's deferral pattern) while the switch is staged, but that would require re-evaluating in the next review.
